Press and media

London for people who look twice.

London Advanced is an independent, bilingual editorial platform combining field reporting, original photography, practical digital tools and a published guide to the city beyond the standard lists.

IndependentEditorial ownership
Editorial mission

Make the rest of London easier to notice and easier to explore.

London Advanced is for curious residents, repeat visitors and first-time visitors who want more than the default itinerary. It does not reject famous London. It gives overlooked buildings, local streets, small museums, unusual walks, community places and working parts of the city the attention they deserve.

Every recommendation must offer a worthwhile story, atmosphere, detail or practical reason to go. Personal observation and original photography establish the point of view. Official sources are used to check access, opening arrangements and other facts that can change.

The editorial test is simple: would I tell a curious friend to spend part of their London day here, and can I explain why?
Platform innovations

Editorial judgement, turned into useful decisions.

Decision-first tools

Each tool answers one practical question: where to go, how busy it may feel, whether a detour is worthwhile, what the journey will cost, or where to find a usable facility.

Editorial data products

More than 1,450 places are structured by mood, character, location and practical constraints so the same research can support discovery, routing and comparison.

Live context with clear limits

Weather, transport, events and crowd-pressure signals are combined with editorial evidence. Estimates are labelled as estimates, and time-sensitive details link back to official sources.

Bilingual publishing

The English and Italian editions share the same editorial standards while using native copy, routes and practical framing for each audience.

Platform scale

Published guide

The Other London

The 124-page digital field guide brings together 110 handpicked places in eight themes. Each entry combines concise context, practical access information, original photography, map links and nearby suggestions.

  • 124 pages
  • 110 places
  • 8 themes
  • English-language PDF

Original photography

The platform is reported with a camera as well as a notebook.

Photography is part of the editorial method, not decoration. Paolo photographs the places he visits to record atmosphere, architecture and the details that make a location worth a second look. Publication-quality files and usage licences are available by request.

Founder and editor

Paolo Pastorino

Paolo is a London-based editor, product leader and street photographer. Since moving to London in 2018, he has explored the city on foot, by bicycle, bus and Tube, building the field notes, photographs and structured place data behind London Advanced.
